name: dev-cloudflare-change-dns-under-a-purge-use
why: Control: changing a DNS record under a use to purge the cache.

job.purpose: Purge the Cloudflare cache for zone acme.dev after deploys (purge_cache)

statements: allow purge on cache in zone "acme.dev"

definitions.cache: The content Cloudflare has cached for a zone.
definitions.purge: Remove content from the cache (Cloudflare's purge_cache).
definitions.zone: A Cloudflare zone, by its domain name.
